name: Bell Toggle
description: Pill-shaped notify toggle button with a bell icon that rings on activation, while the label crossfades and the pill width morphs between off and on text. Optional counter badge and sound waves.
contents: Pill button with bell icon and crossfading off/on label
Optional sound wave arcs beside the bell
Optional red count badge showing the number, capped at 9+
Optional clapper dot under the bell
behavior: Click or Enter/Space toggles the on/off state
Pill width springs between the two label widths and colors swap to the on palette
Bell swings with decaying amplitude and waves pulse on activation by pointer
Increasing count while on triggers a small wobble ring
Pressed scale-down feedback, hover tint on fine pointers
Keyboard toggles and reduced motion users get no spring or ring, state changes instantly
Works controlled via pressed or uncontrolled via defaultPressed
editableByProps: Off and on labels, accessible label, custom icon
Off and on colors and backgrounds, corner radius, size preset
Ring amplitude, passes, decay, duration, pivot, crossfade time and reveal bounce
Count, badge visibility and colors, waves and clapper toggles
Controlled or uncontrolled state, change callback, disabled

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or change size presets or their dimensions
Change the wobble strength when count increases
Change the spring feel of the pill width morph
Change the bell shape drawn in clapper mode

fixed: Requires motion and @hugeicons/react with @hugeicons/core-free-icons, and Tailwind CSS with arbitrary value and starting: variants
Client component using Web Animations API, DOMMatrix and ResizeObserver
Badge only shows when on and count is above 0
Unknown size value falls back to md
Clapper mode replaces the icon prop with a built-in bell drawing
Ring and wave animations only run on pointer activation, never on keyboard
Label widths are measured after fonts load to size the pill
Button height, padding, font size and icon size come from the size preset
